ValidationRule.description: Claims with orders created cannot be changed to earlier statuses
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IsClaim__c && ( NOT(ISBLANK( OrderId__c )) || NOT(ISBLANK( CompensationOrderId__c ))) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Agreement')) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Execution')) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The claim cannot be moved to the selected status because related orders have already been created
